FN-11YTG33-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 27
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 01/08/2026
House Bill 27 as introduced could decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2027, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the additional amounts
contributed to catastrophe savings accounts due to the increased caps on contributions provided
by this bill.
Page 1

FN-11YTG33-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 27
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 01/30/2026
House Bill 27 as passed the House of Representatives could decrease receipts to the Education
Trust Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
additional amounts contributed to catastrophe savings accounts due to the increased caps on
contributions provided by this bill.
